title: Long March 2D / unknown payload (Jiuquan LA-94, SLS-2 / 603)

azimuth_deg.note: great-circle bearing from pad to centroid 35.554N 98.863E (614 km) of NOTAM ZLHW A5728/26 temporary danger area, SFC-UNL, valid 2026-11-11 11:32-12:05Z (= LL2 window exactly); only notice found for this window; area is INFERRED to be the stage-1 impact zone; implies i~99.2 deg (non-rotating) i.e. SSO-class

payload_kg.note: FITTED to reach the assumed orbit at the published typical vernier cutoff; payload unknown (LL2 'Unknown Payload'); fitted value is NOT an estimate

insertion_alt_km.assumption: orbit unpublished (LL2 orbit 'Unknown'); 500 km circular ASSUMED = LM-2D published 1.9 t / 500 km SSO reference orbit (huijiwiki); SSO class inferred from NOTAM bearing

header_notes: T0 = LL2 NET 2026-11-11T11:40:00Z (Wed 11 Nov 3:40 am PST; window 11:32-12:05Z; NOTAM ZLHW A5728/26 window identical). Payload and orbit unknown. Event times = SAST TYPICAL LM-2D sequence (huijiwiki), not this flight's. UNTUNED: no altitude/range knots published.

t_s.src: https://sat.huijiwiki.com/wiki/长征二号丁 typical sequence '星箭分离 737.1 s'

deploy.src: SAST typical LM-2D sequence via huijiwiki: payload separation T+737.1 s (TYPICAL, not flight-specific)
deploy.label: Payload separation (typical sequence)

area_m2.derived: pi x (3.35 m / 2)^2, LM-2D S2 diameter

notes: Typical-sequence residual-propellant venting at T+1152.1 s (deorbit of S2 after separation) is not modelled; it does not affect the payload orbit.
